profile.positioning: I’m Isabela Castillo, VP of People at Sentinel Insights, an AI-driven cybersecurity company poised to disrupt the threat detection landscape. I lead all aspects of our people strategy – from talent acquisition and development to compensation and culture – with a relentless focus on building a high-performing, diverse, and engaged team.  My background is a bit unique; before joining Sentinel, I spent several years as a Talent Partner at Nova Ventures, a leading seed-stage VC firm. This experience gave me a front-row seat to the qualities that make companies truly thrive, and I bring that investor mindset to my work every day. I'm passionate about identifying and nurturing exceptional talent, particularly in the AI/ML space, and I’m always looking to connect with individuals who share that passion.  Right now, I'm laser-focused on scaling our engineering organization to meet the demands of our rapid growth and expanding our reach into new markets.  I believe a strong people function isn't just about hiring; it's about creating an environment where innovation flourishes and every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work.  I’m eager to build relationships with other People Leaders, AI/ML experts, and those involved in building the future of work.
